name: ReelMatch — Letterboxd recommendations
description: Turns your Letterboxd ratings into film recommendations, each with a real reason. Runs entirely in your browser. Unofficial.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://letterboxd.com https://api.themoviedb.org; img-src 'self' data: https://image.tmdb.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; media-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; worker-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
